_note: Unreal / Streetscape-JSON consumer settings. Nothing in sources/derive/ reads this file. The adapter emits the Streetscape frame of projects/one/docs/BRIEF.md 4.2; the x100 / Y-flip / yaw sign to Unreal are applied ONLY by the Unreal plugin and are quoted here for the record.

frame.statement: x = E - E0 (east), y = N - N0 (north), z = ODN metres. Unreal: X_ue = 100*x, Y_ue = -100*y, Z_ue = 100*z (cm). yaw_ue = bearing - 90 = -heading_deg.

landscape.clipped_fill_note: The h16 cannot carry a hole, so the cells step 05 wrote as NoData (outside the clip) are filled with the nearest kept height. The nearest neighbour is found over the WHOLE SITE mosaic, once, not inside one tile: neighbouring tiles share a row of samples, and filling per tile made each of them invent that row from its own cells -- 35,951 shared samples of the Thanet product differed, worst 10.95 m, and the landscape importer had to pick a side. landscape_manifest.seam_qa measures every shared sample of the product this run wrote.
landscape.note: per_unit 128 and offset 32768 are the engine's own (LANDSCAPE_ZSCALE = 1/128, MidValue 32768, Engine/Source/Runtime/Landscape/Public/LandscapeDataAccess.h:13,27); with the landscape actor's Z scale = z_scale_cm the engine height in cm is exactly 100 * z_m to 0.78 cm. The encodable window is -256.0..+255.99 m; range_limit_m keeps a 1 m margin and the adapter REFUSES a site outside it rather than clamping the way GetTexHeight (LandscapeDataAccess.h:35) silently would. visibility_ramp_px: the visibility weight ramps from 2/3 on the clip line to 1 over ramp/3 px into the cut so the 2/3 iso-line is the line itself.
landscape.cliffs_note: The data holds cliff faces at 65-84 degrees (terrain_manifest.slope_qa). Import at 1 m (513 verts per 512 m tile), never resample, and compare the in-engine slope against slope_qa copied into landscape_manifest.json.

streetscape.thin_note: max distance of any step-06 vertex from the centripetal Catmull-Rom through the kept points (the schema's interpolant); 0 keeps every vertex.
streetscape.overlay_lift_note: renderers re-drape overlay.pts and lift 0.3 m; z in the file is the nearest step-06 vertex, informative
streetscape.structure_flags_note: flags.bridge / flags.tunnel are carried through from the step-06/11 record and mean the way is NOT on the ground it is draped on: the pipeline samples the DTM under the structure, unadjusted (sources/derive/06_build_networks.py 15-16), so a bridge way dives into whatever is below it and a tunnel way rides over the hill it passes through. 92 bridge and 59 tunnel ways at Thanet, 1.83 km and 5.48 km. Two consumers already act on it: projects/one/Tools/conform_landscape.py does not burn their corridor (the ground under a structure belongs to whatever passes below) and projects/one/Tools/road_fusion_audit.py counts and names them instead of gating them. The DECK elevation is still the draped ground and is the open half of the treatment - see the geometry core.
streetscape.edge_rule: edge_left/edge_right = edge_uk_kerb unless sidewalk is 'no'/'separate' or cls is a path class; sides from sidewalk / sidewalk:left / sidewalk:right, default both; pavement_width_m = pav via a whole-spline segment when pav != 1.8 (0 allowed: kerb without pavement)

barrier.height_source: step 11 record field h (metres, parsed or defaulted there, see h_src); default_height_m below applies only to a record without h and is counted
barrier.offset_rule: offset_m = -thickness_m/2 (hedge: -width_m/2) so the geometry is centred on the OSM way; 'kerb' -> edge_uk_kerb with pavement_width_m 0 and no barrier; 'hedge' -> the hedge renderer
barrier.note: Opinions, not survey. First matching rule wins; the bare-class rules are the defaults. A cls with no rule is skipped and counted.

streetscape.materials_hints: copied into every document's materials block from projects/one/schema/examples/test_stretch.json materials
streetscape.note: footway/path/steps/cycleway/bridleway/track/pedestrian are Renderer-A flat ribbons with path_*/road_pedestrian profiles and NO edge renderer. All classes present in tuning.json roads.widths_m must appear in road_profile_by_class; the adapter refuses otherwise.

massing.note: rings to local metres; base_z/skirt unchanged (Z is up in this frame).

furniture.note: x,y local; z kept (null = drape); bearing kept; heading_deg = ((90 - bearing + 180) mod 360) - 180 in [-180, 180). The loader's yaw_ue = bearing - 90 is NOT written per record (BRIEF 4.2).
